chunks: Surely scheming is the work of Satan that he may cause the faithful grief; but he cannot harm them unless God dispense. So in God should the believers place their trust.

key_terms.لْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ: Let the believers place their trust

ai.seo_question: What is the nature of Satan's influence on believers and how does God's permission relate to it?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse clarifies that Satan's whispers during private deliberations (najwa) are designed to induce anxiety and doubt among the faithful, yet his power is contingent upon divine permission (idhn). This underscores the concept of tawakkul, where believers maintain spiritual resilience by recognizing that external trials are ultimately under God's control, a theme emphasized by Imams like Al-Sadiq as a test of inner conviction.
